## What this site is

A one-person professional-services practice. The operator handles
strategy, design and engineering end-to-end on every engagement —
there is no team, no account manager, no junior delivery. Engagements
are productized into three tiers, scoped weekly, and priced for
outcomes rather than hours.

## Services

- **The Sprint** — 4-week fixed-scope engagement at $8,000. One
  contained outcome. Good for a landing-page rebuild, a single
  automation, or a critical fix on an existing product.
  https://ferozarshad.com/services
- **The Build** — 8 to 16-week full-stack delivery from $25,000.
  Production SaaS, headless commerce, or autonomous AI systems.
  Strategy through ship.
  https://ferozarshad.com/services/full-stack-saas
- **The Retainer** — $5,000/month, 3-month minimum, 20 senior hours
  per month. An on-call senior partner for founders who have shipped.
  https://ferozarshad.com/services

### Service categories

- AI & Workflow Automation (n8n, OpenAI, Python pipelines, scrapers)
  https://ferozarshad.com/services/ai-automation
- Full-Stack SaaS Architecture (Next.js, Python FastAPI, real-time)
  https://ferozarshad.com/services/full-stack-saas
- Headless / Premium E-Commerce (Shopify Hydrogen, WooCommerce scaling)
  https://ferozarshad.com/services/ecommerce
- Custom Web Design & Development
  https://ferozarshad.com/services/custom-web-design

## How engagements run

- Two long discovery calls in week one. Brief comes back in the
  client's own words, sharpened.
- Clickable prototype by day 7.
- Weekly **Friday demos** in the inbox — production code, not slides.
- Direction changes happen in days, not sprint cycles.
- Senior-level decisions, in writing, on every line.
- Mutual NDA up front. Full IP assignment on delivery.
- 30-day post-ship retainer included.

## Selected case studies (verifiable under NDA)

- **Heritage Apothecary Shopify rebuild** — +42% conversion rate,
  $1.1M revenue across 7 months, 2.1× revenue per visitor.
  https://ferozarshad.com/portfolio/million-dollar-ecommerce
- **Autonomous n8n support routing** — 18,000 tickets/month
  end-to-end intake → classify → reply-draft → route, in production
  for 9 months. ~71% reduction in first-pass triage cost.
  https://ferozarshad.com/portfolio/ai-support-bot
- **Enterprise B2B lead-gen SaaS** — 14 data sources, 12M-row
  Postgres dedupe, 0.08s p50 query latency, multi-tenant from day one.
  https://ferozarshad.com/portfolio/lead-gen-scraper
- **YouTube → SEO pipeline** — automated transcript-to-article CMS
  with structured-data generation. Multi-channel publication.
  https://ferozarshad.com/portfolio/youtube-blog-automation

## Tech stack the operator uses

Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Python (FastAPI, Django, Selenium),
Node.js, n8n, OpenAI, Prisma, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Shopify Hydrogen,
Tailwind CSS, Docker, Vercel.

## What this practice does NOT do

- No retainer-only relationships under 3 months.
- No equity-only / "let's partner" arrangements.
- No projects below the $8k floor (paid strategy memo only).
- No subcontracting to anonymous junior delivery teams.
